portfolio.title: Vending Machine GUI Application (Python, PySimpleGUI)
portfolio.contents:
This project is a graphical vending machine simulator built with Python and PySimpleGUI. Users can browse products, add items to a virtual basket, and proceed through a simulated checkout process, including cash insertion and change calculation. The application features dynamic image resizing, real-time basket updates, and purchase logging to both text and CSV files. It demonstrates practical use of GUI design, file I/O, and state management in Python.

- Graphical User Interface: Provides an intuitive GUI for users to interact with the vending machine, built using PySimpleGUI.
- Product Display: Shows a list of products with images, names, and prices, organized in columns.
- Basket Management: Allows users to add products to a basket, adjust quantities, and view the current basket contents.
- Dynamic Image Resizing: Automatically resizes product images for consistent display in the interface.
- Checkout Process: Calculates the total price and manages the checkout process.
- Cash Insertion Simulation: Lets users simulate inserting cash in various denominations and tracks the remaining amount needed.
- Change Calculation: Calculates and displays the correct change in Thai Baht denominations after payment.
- Purchase Logging: Saves purchase details, including items, quantities, total price, cash inserted, and change, to both text and CSV files for record-keeping.
- Real-Time Updates: Updates the date/time and basket totals in real time within the interface.
- Multi-Window Navigation: Supports navigation between product selection, basket, payment, and purchase success screens.
- User Feedback: Provides clear feedback and instructions at each step, including successful purchase confirmation and change breakdown.

portfolio.title: My Portfolio Website
portfolio.contents:
Phanlop's portfolio website is a dynamic and interactive platform designed to showcase my skills, projects, achievements, internships, academic activities, and education. It combines modern design, responsive layouts, and backend functionality to provide a seamless user experience. Here's a brief overview of the features:

1. Frontend Features
# Home Page:
Displays an introduction with animations like typewriter effects and fade-ins.
Sections for skills, projects, achievements, internships, academic activities, and education.
Dynamic content loading via API integration.

# Portfolio Details:
Shows detailed information about a specific portfolio entry, including title, contents, event location, event date, and thumbnail.
Displays associated skill tags with dynamic styling.
Includes a gallery with lightbox functionality for viewing images.

# Login:
Provides user authentication with a login form.
Validates JWT tokens for session management and redirects users based on token validity.

2. Backend Features
# Display Portfolio:
Backend dashboard for managing portfolio entries.
Features a data table with pagination, filtering, and bulk actions.

# Create Portfolio:
Allows users to create new portfolio entries with details like title, contents, event location, event date, and portfolio type.
Supports thumbnail and gallery image uploads.

# Edit Portfolio:
Enables editing of portfolio details, thumbnails, and skill associations.

# Edit Gallery:
Provides functionality to manage gallery images for portfolio entries, including uploads and deletions.

# Manage Skill Types:
Allows administrators to add, edit, and delete skill types.
Includes color selection for skill type categorization.

# Edit Skill Type:
Enables editing of individual skill types, including name and color customization.

3. Technical Highlights
# React Framework: Modular and scalable frontend development.
# Node.js and Express.js: Efficient backend API handling and server-side operations.
# API Integration: Dynamic data fetching and updates.
# Lightbox Gallery: Interactive image viewing experience.
# Responsive Design: Ensures compatibility across devices.
# Toast Notifications: Real-time feedback for user actions.
# JWT Authentication: Secure session management.

portfolio.title: React Online Shopping App
portfolio.contents:
This project is a React-based shopping cart application designed to practice and demonstrate the use of Redux for state management. It includes a reducer, productReducer, which manages the application's state related to cart items and total price. Key features include:

# Adding Items to Cart: Users can add products to the cart, with each product represented as an object containing an id and other details.

This project showcases the use of Redux actions and reducers to handle state transitions and demonstrates best practices for managing application state in a React environment. It is structured to provide hands-on experience with Redux concepts such as actions, reducers, and immutable state updates.

# Removing Items from Cart: Users can remove specific items from the cart by their id.

# Decreasing Item Quantity: Users can decrease the quantity of a specific item in the cart.
Clearing the Cart: Users can reset the cart to an empty state.

# Updating Total Price: The total price of items in the cart is dynamically updated.

portfolio.title: Air Monitor Pro (IoT Mini project)
portfolio.contents:
Air Monitor Pro: Smart Industrial Environmental Guard
Air Monitor Pro is a comprehensive IoT ecosystem designed for real-time environmental monitoring in warehouses, laboratories, and industrial spaces. By integrating high-precision hardware with a cloud-based Next.js dashboard, the system provides 24/7 surveillance of air quality, safety thresholds, and early fire detection.

System Features
• 4-in-1 Sensing: Real-time tracking of PM2.5 (dust), Gas (CO2/Smoke), Temperature, and Humidity.
• Intelligent Alert System: Local visual/audio alarms (LED & Buzzer) coupled with a digital "System Alert Log."
• Over-the-Air (OTA) Configuration: Remote adjustment of sensor thresholds via MQTT without reflashing the hardware.
• Responsive Dashboard: A sleek interface featuring Dark/Light modes and 7-day historical analytics.

Hardware Overview
The Air Monitor Pro hardware is housed in a rugged, industrial-grade enclosure designed for wall-mounting. It features a modular internal layout for easy maintenance and clear external indicators for immediate status checks.

Technology Stack
Software & Cloud
• Frontend: Next.js (React) - Optimized for high-speed performance.
• Backend: MongoDB - Persistent storage for alert logs.
• Communication: MQTT (via PubSubClient) - Low-latency bi-directional messaging.
Hardware Component List
• Microcontroller: ESP32 (Dual-core, WiFi)
• Environment Sensor: DHT22 (Temp & Humidity)
• Air Quality Sensor: Sharp GP2Y1010AU0F (PM2.5)
• Gas Sensor: MQ-Series (CO2/Smoke)
• Display: 16x2 LCD with I2C

portfolio.title: Thaivel, a tourism website
portfolio.contents:
THAIVEL is a sophisticated full-stack travel platform designed to bridge the gap between curious travelers and the authentic cultural essence of Thailand. Developed as a showcase for the International Web Design Contest (iWDC), this project highlights modern web standards, responsive design, and AI integration to simplify travel discovery.

Abstract
In a world of information overload, THAIVEL provides a curated, aesthetically pleasing gateway to Thailand’s diverse attractions. From the misty mountains of the North to the pristine beaches of the South, the platform organizes destinations by region and interest, allowing users to find their perfect trip through an intuitive, data-driven interface.

Key Features
• Regional Exploration: A comprehensive breakdown of Thailand’s 6 unique regions with localized culture, food, and landmark insights.
• Smart Categorization: Filterable discovery engine for Cafes, Nature, Restaurants, Street Food, Temples, and Urban destinations.
• Tuktuk Driver AI: A custom-engineered AI travel assistant that provides conversational recommendations and local "wisdom" to help users plan their adventures.
• Interactive Cartography: Integrated dark-themed maps with custom pins for visual spatial orientation across the Kingdom.
• Mobile-First Architecture: A fully responsive design that maintains high-fidelity visuals and usability on smartphones for travelers on the go.
• Social & Navigational Integration: Direct links to Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and Google Maps for every featured location.

Tech Stack
• Frontend: Next.js (React Framework)
• Styling: Tailwind CSS
• Database: MySQL for structured destination and regional data management.
